description: This file appears to be a shell script used for setting up and tearing down Virtual Tunnel Interface (VTI) configurations in a networking context. It includes functions for initializing configurations, setting up VTI in IPv4 and IPv6, handling dependencies, and notifying errors.

methods.name: vti_generic_setup
methods.description: Sets up a generic VTI tunnel with provided configuration parameters.

methods.name: vti_setup
methods.description: Sets up an IPv4 VTI based on configuration, including IP address and peer address dependencies.

methods.name: proto_vti_setup
methods.description: Wrapper to initialize VTI setup with 'vtiip' mode.

methods.name: vti6_setup
methods.description: Sets up an IPv6 VTI with necessary IP address and dependency checks.

methods.name: proto_vti6_setup
methods.description: Wrapper to initialize IPv6 VTI setup with 'vtiip6' mode.

methods.name: vti_generic_init_config
methods.description: Initializes generic configuration options for VTI protocols.
